crossRefs.note: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king. Nabal’s heart was merry…
When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing…
David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except…
In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
“ ‘ “Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and…
They were arrogant, and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
Those who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” ’
But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the…
They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please…
As it was in the days of Noah, even so will it be also in the days of the Son of Man.
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and…
But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,
translations.bsb: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark.
translations.kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
